_description: Custom Reports KEPT-REPORT scenario (v2) — builds a SESSIONS report over a CUSTOM date range, saves it, and INTENTIONALLY does NOT delete it. Column selection now comes from the CATALOG file (choose-fields.catalog.json): 'fields' lists catalog keys, or use "ALL" to select every available field. EVERY value below is editable from this file alone: dateFrom/dateTo (YYYY-MM-DD or {{today_minus_N}}/{{today_plus_N}} templates), branchFilter/systemFilter/visitStatusFilter (SELECT OPTION TEXTS), fields (catalog keys or ALL), saveReport (DYNAMIC = unique name per run), frequency (one_time|weekly|monthly|quarterly), visibility (private|public), recipients (required by the server form).

_config._configNote: rangeMode=custom keeps the date inputs EDITABLE (preset modes disable them). Column keys are matched by checkbox-ID SUFFIX; ambiguous keys fail fast with the matching ids. Preview columns always render in PAGE order regardless of JSON order.

_fields.subject: sessions
_fields._fields_note: Keys come from choose-fields.catalog.json (66 fields, 6 groups). Use "ALL" to select every field, or list any subset of catalog keys.
